column1: # The measured check of each unit with a committed proof or finding on GitHub's 16-core runner (ubuntu-24.04-16core),
# from which `oft plan` chooses each check job's runner (plan.runner).  The table decides only where a job runs,
#   minutes   the longest successful check job of the unit alone, from start to end, in this repository's
#             release-check and pr runs of 22 October to 2 November 2026.  openssl/hashtable's 360.4 is a lower
#             bound: GitHub's 6-hour cap cancelled that job on 1 November.
#   peak_gib  the largest peak memory a check of the unit reached on that runner (16 CPUs), 28 October to 1 November
#             2026, as reported by a build of `oft check` that samples its process's cgroup every 2 seconds; empty
# A unit not listed, or with an empty column, counts as over that column's threshold.
